title: Wisdom Paves the Way
subject: English
summary: “Wisdom Paves the Way” is an inspiring story that teaches us the importance of wisdom, patience and good decision-making. It shows that intelligence alone is not enough to solve problems; we also need to think carefully and act wisely. The story explains how a person can overcome difficult situations by using common sense and understanding rather than anger or force. It encourages us to remain calm, learn from our experiences and choose the right path in life. The chapter teaches us that wisdom, patience and thoughtful actions help us overcome challenges and achieve success.
